error_chain: Next.js generates internal webpack config with react-dom resolve alias
Customer adds Module Federation plugin SharePlugin to share react-dom
Webpack resolver encounters two competing definitions for the react-dom module
NormalModuleFactory raises module resolution conflict during compilation
trigger_conditions: Next.js sets resolve.alias react-dom to vendored copy in webpack-config.ts
Module Federation registers react-dom in the shared scope via SharePlugin
The shared scope and the resolve.alias both resolve before NormalModuleFactory creates the module
